answer: Delayed-Seed Admission Lottery: each cycle, a public beacon derives a seed after registrations close, so identities cannot precompute favorable hashes. A registration is admitted only if hash(seed, id) falls below a threshold set by confirmed usage; rejected slots pay a re-entry cost that scales with failed attempts. Like a reef filtering currents, the beacon gate blocks mass pre-registration. Every fake identity must also run a live liveness kernel check, costing compute and time per attempt, and a randomized sonnet-style challenge-response each cycle.
